name: How does a custom steel building compare to traditional wood-frame construction?
description: Steel provides wide clear-span interiors, fire and termite resistance, and lower maintenance, though it requires precise upfront engineering and slab anchoring.

mainEntity.name: How does a custom steel building compare to traditional wood-frame construction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Steel framing delivers much greater clear-span capability, faster structural erection, and superior resistance to termites, rot, and fire compared to traditional dimensional lumber. A practical tradeoff is that steel requires rigorous upfront engineering and precise foundation anchoring, as framing components cannot be easily trimmed or adjusted on-site like wood studs. For large workshops, commercial warehouses, or equipment barns, steel provides lower long-term maintenance and retains structural integrity without settling or warping over time.
